instructions: Start with execute: return await flowbound.docs({ topic: "start" }). When running locally in a coding agent, pass the absolute path of the open project as the project argument. Workflows live in Git. From chat, save edits with workflow-save, check with workflow-change, and publish only when the person asks. Share Flowbound page links.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Find Flowbound tools
tools.description: Find Flowbound tools and read their inputs and prices. Leave query empty to list every tool. Search docs for the current guide, available without a shell. Flowbound runs GTM workflows (list building, research, enrichment) and keeps every paid fact, on the person's own data provider keys, under their permissions.

query.description: words to look for, like: run, table, import, lookup, firecrawl

tools.name: execute
tools.title: Run code against Flowbound
tools.description: Run JavaScript that calls Flowbound tools and returns what you need. Each tool is an async function: `return await flowbound.runs({ state: "running" })`, `await flowbound["schedule-run"]({ name })`. Call several with Promise.all, filter big answers before returning them, console.log to see steps. It reaches only the tools, as you, with your rights: no files, no network, no keys. Find tools and their inputs with search first.

code.description: the body of an async function; return the answer
